about: Rendered reference films: the 3D lane's dummy (dealer3d/) performing one step as the bank's camera sees it, its hands read off an approved deal of a real dealer. A recipe whose reference rule is renderad or renderad-eller-samma-plats (data/order-methods.json) takes the film for its step and seat from here before any take of the bank (src/order-model.ts referenceCandidates, src/order-methods.ts referenceByRule), and tools/order-store.ts copies it into the order's folder with its hash. One entry per film: id; edge (the step it shows in the graph's notation: READY>P4.C1 a pinch deal to seat 4, READY-B>P4.C1 a drag, READY-C>P4.C1 a deal with two hands, IDLE>READY-C the entry to anchor 2.3); path, always assets/references/docka/<id>/source.mp4 (media, outside Git); sha256 of that file; seconds; fromDeal (the take its hands are read off); lays (the hand that lays the card, absent: the left); check (the film's own reference check, src/deal-check.ts checkReference: pass, clean, codes). A film is listed only when its file lies there and it ends as the seat's last picture does (the hand's side and the fingers on the card; ../.claude/skills/bestalla-film/SKILL.md). The 3D lane makes the films in a working folder of the scratch (../slask/blackjack-dealer/<task>/, or where DEALER_SLASK points); a film is copied here with its hash checked and a receipt.json beside it, and a film made again gets a new letter, never the same id. Of two films of the same edge the one listed later is offered first: a film made again is listed after the one it replaces. A film that deals no card (an entry to an anchor) has no check and no laying hand.
